transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Cymbal Telecom Business Support. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Hi Alex. My name is Jessica Lopez, calling from OmniMedia Group. I'm looking at our latest bill and it seems to be higher than usual.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can certainly help you with that, Ms. Lopez. To access your account details securely, could you please provide me with your Customer ID?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, of course. The customer ID is CUST-2015.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. I have CUST-2015. And for security verification, could you please provide the 6-digit account security PIN?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: The PIN is 4-9-4-9-8-5.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect, thank you for verifying. I've successfully accessed the OmniMedia Group account. I see you're on our Business Fiber Gigabit plan. Now, you mentioned the bill was higher this month?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That's right. Our bill is normally a flat $199 plus taxes, but this latest invoice is for $219. It's a $20 increase.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, I am pulling up your most recent invoice now. Please allow me just a moment to review the line items.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No problem.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for your patience. Yes, I see the invoice total of $219 before taxes. It looks like the base rate for the Business Fiber Gigabit service has returned to its standard price.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Standard price? What does that mean? I thought our rate was fixed.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I understand the confusion. Let me check your service agreement history. It appears that when the account was set up, it included a $20 per month promotional discount for the first 12 months of service.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh. I think I remember that now. But that was a year ago, I wasn't expecting it to just jump up.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, I can confirm that the 12-month promotional period concluded with your last billing cycle. The service has now reverted to the standard monthly rate of $219 for the gigabit plan.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: I see. Well, we've been a good customer and always pay on time. Is there any other promotion or a loyalty discount you can apply to bring the price back down?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's an excellent question, and I appreciate your loyalty to Cymbal Telecom. I can definitely check our system for any available offers for your account. May I place you on a brief hold for one to two minutes while I check?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, that's fine. I'll wait.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. Please hold.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Ms. Lopez? Thank you so much for holding.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: I'm here. Did you find anything?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I did. I've reviewed the available loyalty offers. While the original sign-up promotion isn't available, I can offer you a 'Business Loyalty' discount of $15 per month for the next 12 months.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: So, fifteen dollars off instead of twenty? That would make the new bill... $204 a month?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That is correct. Your monthly rate would be $204, plus any applicable taxes and fees, for the next year.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Hmm. Is that really the best you can do? We rely on this internet for our business, but every dollar counts.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand. Let me just double check the system for any other stackable credits... one moment.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Alright, thank you for waiting again. The $15 per month discount is the best recurring offer available for this plan at the moment. It's designed specifically for our valued long-term business clients.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: I suppose that's better than nothing. It's just frustrating to see prices go up.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I understand completely. How about this: I can apply that new $15 loyalty discount starting today. And as a gesture of goodwill for the confusion on this month's bill, I can also apply a one-time credit of $10 to your current invoice.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: A one-time ten dollar credit? For this current bill?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes. That would bring this month's bill down from $219 to $209. Then, starting with your next invoice, the new monthly rate of $204 would take effect for the following 12 months.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay... a $10 credit now and the rate becomes $204 going forward. Yes, that sounds fair. Let's do that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent. I'm glad we could find a solution that works for you. Please stay on the line while I apply these changes to your account. It will just take me a minute.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Alright, thank you, Alex.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, Ms. Lopez, everything is processed. I have successfully added the 'Business Loyalty Discount' of $15 per month. The system confirms this is active for 12 billing cycles.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Great. And the credit for this month?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, the one-time $10 credit has also been applied to your current outstanding balance. Your new total due for this billing period is $209 plus tax. You should be able to see this reflected if you log into your Cymbal online portal within the next hour.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Perfect. That's very helpful.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm happy I could assist. Just to confirm and summarize for you: we've adjusted this month's bill to $209, and your ongoing monthly rate for the Business Fiber Gigabit service will be $204 for the next 12 months. Is that all correct on your end?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, that all sounds correct. I've made a note of it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Wonderful. And I've also added a note to the account detailing our conversation and the new promotional rate we've applied today. The reference number for this interaction, should you need it, is 774-B-91.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, 774-B-91. Got it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We do value your business with Cymbal Telecom, and I'm glad we could resolve this for you today.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Me too. Thank you for your help, Alex. You've been very efficient.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You're very welcome, Ms. Lopez. Was there anything else I could assist you with today? Any questions about your account or other Cymbal services?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No, that was the only thing. I'm all set.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Alright then. I would recommend setting a calendar reminder for about 11 months from now to give us a call and review your account for new promotions before this one expires.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That is a very good idea. I will do that. Thank you for the tip.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Of course. We're always here to help.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, well have a good rest of your day.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You as well. Thank you for being a Cymbal Telecom customer, and have a wonderful day.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Thanks, bye.
